newsitem.title: USA: Regent Bancshares names Joel Hyman CFO.
newsitem.headline: Regent Bancshares names Joel Hyman CFO.

text.p: Regent Bancshares Corp (Nasdaq: RBNK) and its wholly-owned subsidiary, Regent National Bank, have elected Joel E. Hyman executive vice president/chief financial officer and treasurer.

Hyman will be responsible for: 1) financial operations, including all areas of accounting, asset/liability management and financial planning; 2) treasury activities, including the management of the investment portfolio and liquidity; and 3) investor relations.
He will report to CEO John J. Lyons. Hyman has 25 years of banking experience with institutions in Connecticut.
Most recently he spent three years as executive vice president/chief financial officer & treasurer of Farmers & Mechanics Bank of Middletown, Conn.
